row-actions.intent: Compact row actions retain row context, focus and dismissal.
visualStates: phone menu open near bottom edge
limitations: DOM tests prove interaction, not rendered geometry.

feedback.intent: A reversible saved action retains Undo until explicitly dismissed; temporary success uses Toast.
limitations: Do not use durable UndoToast for ordinary transient success.

forms.intent: Validation belongs to the field and preserves its label, hint and error relationships.
limitations: Geometry needs the production capture at narrow and desktop widths.
forms.testCommand: pnpm exec vitest run src/components/ui/form.test.tsx -t Field

settings.intent: An editor preserves settings navigation context and exposes its current row.
limitations: JSDOM scrolling tests use measured rectangles; capture verifies actual layout.

handoff.intent: Show the responsible person, next action and persisted outcome. Use a DB read-back to prove the saved state.
limitations: Existing runnable example proves requested/acknowledged/handled persistence only. It does not implement or endorse that wording as the approved helper-assignment UX; issue #2851 governs the product redesign.
handoff.testCommand: pnpm exec vitest run src/db/help-requests.test.ts -t 'moves one request'
